scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run -w @allisteam/api dev" "npm run -w @allisteam/web dev"
scripts.build: npm run -w @allisteam/api build && npm run -w @allisteam/web build
scripts.typecheck: npm run -w @allisteam/shared typecheck && npm run -w @allisteam/api typecheck && npm run -w @allisteam/web typecheck
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build:shared && npm run test && npm run build
